response.overview: "This is Anfield" released in 2000. The film focuses on the history of Liverpool FC from the management of Shankly to Houllier, providing viewers with an in-depth look at the football club's achievements and highlights. With a PAL signal standard and English language, this VHS tape is a must-have for fans of Liverpool FC and football enthusiasts alike. Produced in the United Kingdom, this video tape captures the essence of Anfield and chronicles the club's legacy.
